notes: Office aggregates only. Each level is computed from its own summed inputs (own-level rows + all children). value is in the metric unit; numerator and denominator are the summed inputs behind it.

atc_loss.label: AT&C loss
atc_loss.formula: 100 × (input − min(collection, demand)) ÷ input, MU, 12-month cumulative to the latest month

atc_loss_change_yoy.label: AT&C loss change vs a year earlier
atc_loss_change_yoy.formula: AT&C loss (latest month) − AT&C loss (same month a year earlier), both from summed inputs; when the year-earlier month is more than 10 pts away from the median of it and its two neighbouring months, that median is used instead (flag base_month_outlier)

collection_efficiency.label: Collection efficiency
collection_efficiency.formula: 100 × collection ÷ demand, MU, capped at 100 as in the sheet (uncapped ratio in inputs)

receivable_days.label: Receivables in days of collection
receivable_days.formula: OSD of live consumers (₹ lakh) ÷ average daily collection over the 365 days to the OSD date (₹ lakh)

rem_defaulters_per_1000.label: Defaulters with OSD over ₹5,000 per 1,000 live consumers
rem_defaulters_per_1000.formula: REM OSD > ₹5,000 Total-Count (latest weekly report) ÷ live consumers × 1,000

rem_osd_change_13w.label: Change in OSD over ₹5,000 over 13 weeks
rem_osd_change_13w.formula: 100 × (amount latest − amount 13 weeks earlier) ÷ amount 13 weeks earlier, ₹ lakh

disconnection_action_share.label: Disconnection list acted on
disconnection_action_share.formula: 100 × (fully paid + part paid + disconnected) ÷ consumers on the disconnection list
disconnection_action_share.period: list base dates DOM 2026-08-06, IND/COM 2026-09-07; latest action 2026-10-04

theft_realisation.label: Theft assessment realised
theft_realisation.formula: 100 × payment received ÷ amount assessed (final bill, else provisional) for cases inspected in the 12 months to the latest inspection

nsc_pending_over_30d_share.label: Paid NSC pending over 30 days
nsc_pending_over_30d_share.formula: 100 × pending applications with DelayInSC > 30 days ÷ pending applications (paid, Working)

nsc_pending_avg_days.label: Average age of pending NSC since payment
nsc_pending_avg_days.formula: Σ DelayInSC ÷ pending applications (days from quotation payment to the report date)

nsc_wo_delay_avg.label: Average work-order delay (pending NSC with a WO)
nsc_wo_delay_avg.formula: Σ DelayInWO ÷ pending applications with a work order (payment → work order)

nsc_withheld_network_share.label: Applications withheld for want of network (12 months)
nsc_withheld_network_share.formula: 100 × applications withheld in the 365 days to the report for a network reason (LT infrastructure required, way leave for LT infrastructure, WBSEDCL unable, techno-economically not feasible, transformer location) ÷ all applications withheld in those 365 days

nsc_released_12m.label: New connections released in 12 months (historical NSC)
nsc_released_12m.formula: Σ connections (D + C + I + A + O) with METER_INSTALL_DATE in the 365 days to the latest date

weekly_disposal_share.label: Weekly applications disposed (deposit vs disposal)
weekly_disposal_share.formula: 100 × Σ Total disposed ÷ Σ To be disposed (DOM + COM + IND), last 4 report weeks

mc_pending_over_30d_share.label: Master cards pending over 30 days after meter installation
mc_pending_over_30d_share.formula: 100 × pending master cards with Report Date − Meter Installation Date > 30 days ÷ pending master cards

load_ext_pending_over_90d_share.label: Load extensions pending 3 months or more
load_ext_pending_over_90d_share.formula: 100 × pending load extensions with AGE_MONTHS ≥ 3 ÷ pending load extensions (the page counts AGE_MONTHS ≥ 12 as over a year)

solar_pending_over_30d_share.label: Rooftop solar applications over 30 days old not yet connected
solar_pending_over_30d_share.formula: 100 × applications created more than 30 days before the report without a successful net-meter replacement ÷ applications created more than 30 days before the report

pmsgy_net_metering_share.label: PM Surya Ghar installations net-metered
pmsgy_net_metering_share.formula: 100 × installations completed with a Net Metering Date ÷ installations completed

defective_meter_share.label: Defective meters per live consumer
defective_meter_share.period: defective as on 2026-10-16, consumers as on 2026-09-30

defective_over5y_share.label: Defective meters older than 5 years
defective_over5y_share.formula: 100 × defective meters with a defect over 5 years old ÷ defective meters

unmetered_share.label: Live consumers without a meter
unmetered_share.formula: 100 × live consumers with TYPE_OF_METER "NO METER" ÷ live consumers

smart_meter_installed_share.label: Supplied smart meters installed
smart_meter_installed_share.formula: 100 × meters marked installed (active in HES) ÷ meters supplied
smart_meter_installed_share.period: as on 2025-11-12 (work-order tab date, as the dashboard shows)

smart_meter_ami_push_share.label: Installed smart meters submitted to the AMI portal
smart_meter_ami_push_share.formula: 100 × meters submitted in the AMI portal ÷ meters installed
smart_meter_ami_push_share.period: as on 2025-11-12 (work-order tab date, as the dashboard shows)

meter_utilization_share.label: Issued meters put to use
meter_utilization_share.formula: 100 × ERP meters (issued at least 30 days before the latest ERP entry) found as a new connection or a replacement ÷ those meters

unbilled_3m_per_10k.label: Existing consumers unbilled for 3 months per 10,000 live
unbilled_3m_per_10k.formula: unbilled existing consumers (column Q, the sheet total) ÷ live consumers × 10,000

first_bill_pending_per_10k.label: Connections without a first bill per 10,000 live
first_bill_pending_per_10k.formula: live permanent connections without a first bill (column J, the sheet total) ÷ live consumers × 10,000

low_unit_bill_share.label: Live consumers billed under 10 units a month
low_unit_bill_share.formula: 100 × bills under 10 units incl. zero (column I) ÷ live consumers in the same sheet (column F)

feeder_outage_hours.label: Outage hours per 11 kV feeder per month (SAIDI proxy)
feeder_outage_hours.formula: Σ duration of outages over 5 min (minutes) ÷ 60 ÷ feeder-months, last 12 report months
feeder_outage_hours.naReason: feeder outage data has no CCC column (division and substation only)

feeder_outage_count.label: Outages per 11 kV feeder per month (SAIFI proxy)
feeder_outage_count.formula: Σ outages over 5 min ÷ feeder-months, last 12 report months
feeder_outage_count.naReason: feeder outage data has no CCC column (division and substation only)

feeder_concern_share.label: Feeder-months of concern
feeder_concern_share.formula: 100 × feeder-months averaging ≥ 1 h of outage a day or with ≥ 30 outages ÷ feeder-months (the page's concern rule without the month-on-month jump)
feeder_concern_share.naReason: feeder outage data has no CCC column (division and substation only)

dtr_weighted_outage_hours.label: Outage hours a distribution transformer saw per month (feeder outages spread over DTRs)
dtr_weighted_outage_hours.formula: Σ over DTRs of their 11 kV feeder's outage hours (outages over 5 min) ÷ DTR-months, last 12 report months; feeders matched to DTRs by division + substation + feeder name (else division + feeder name)

docket_open_over_48h_share.label: Open dockets older than 48 hours
docket_open_over_48h_share.formula: 100 × open dockets created ≥ 48 h before the latest docket ÷ open dockets

fault_dockets_open_over_24h_per_10k.label: Fault (technical) dockets open over 24 hours per 10,000 live consumers
fault_dockets_open_over_24h_per_10k.formula: open dockets of a technical problem type (docket.html's list: no power, fuse, DTR, line, meter defective and no power, …) created ≥ 24 h before the latest docket ÷ live consumers × 10,000

docket_closure_days_avg.label: Average time to close a docket
docket_closure_days_avg.formula: Σ Sum of Diff (days) ÷ Σ Count of doc_no, closed dockets
docket_closure_days_avg.period: closed Jan 2023 to Jun 2025 (docket/kpi.html label; the sheet has no date)

cmo_open_share.label: CMO grievances pending with an MZO officer
cmo_open_share.formula: 100 × grievances whose Pending With is an officer (not "Disposed / pending with HQ") ÷ grievances on the report
cmo_open_share.naReason: CMO grievances carry only the district (region); blocks do not map reliably to CCCs or divisions

accidents_fatal_12m.label: Fatal electrical accidents (people) in 12 months
accidents_fatal_12m.formula: count of accidents with Nature of Injury Fatal and Type of Victim Human in the 365 days to the latest accident

safety_rectification_share.label: Unsafe sites found by the safety app that are rectified
safety_rectification_share.formula: 100 × sites with a Rectification done on date ÷ inspected sites (first row per Site ID, as safety_inspection.html counts)

si_works_completed_share.label: Priority system-improvement works completed
si_works_completed_share.formula: 100 × works with Status Completed ÷ works listed
si_works_completed_share.naReason: SI works are listed by division only

capex_balance_aged_share.label: Capex material balance with contractors over 90 days
capex_balance_aged_share.formula: 100 × Net Balance Value with Ageing in Days > 90 ÷ Net Balance Value, latest Reporting Date only

onm_advance_aged_share.label: O&M material advance over 90 days
onm_advance_aged_share.formula: 100 × Mat Balance(Value) of orders created > 90 days before the latest order ÷ Mat Balance(Value)
onm_advance_aged_share.naReason: O&M orders are raised by divisions; the few rows on a CCC cost centre are counted in their division

flags.stale: The data is older than the metric's maxAgeDays on the reference date.
flags.small_base: The denominator (or case count) is below the metric's minBase: the value swings with a few cases.
flags.no_cases: Nothing on the list for this office (zero cases): a share has no value, a count or rate per consumer is 0.
flags.no_rows: The source has no row for this office.
flags.level_not_available: The source cannot place rows at this level (see naReason); score the office without this metric.
flags.includes_own_level_rows: Some inputs sit at this office itself, not in any child (HT / bulk / division-booked rows); ownLevel gives them.
flags.base_month_outlier: The year-earlier loss row looks misplaced (over 10 pts from its neighbouring months); the median of the three months is the base.
flags.low_match_coverage: Under 60 % of this office's DTRs are on feeders matched to the outage data.
flags.details_mixed_as_on_not_used: Defective details mix the 16/10 and 23/10 dumps; only the summary (all 16/10) is used.
flags.storage_copy_behind_sheet: The app reads the Storage copy of pending MC (28/10); the Google sheet is newer (30/10).
flags.pending_withheld_overlap_12: 12 applications are in both the pending (30/10) and withheld (29/10) lists.
flags.ht_region_collections_excluded: Collections booked at region offices (HT) are left out because the consumer OSD sheet has no HT rows.
flags.no_date_in_sheet: The sheet has no report date; the date shown is the mirror copy date or the page label.
flags.feeder_name_match: Feeder outage rows have no CCC; feeders are tied to CCCs through the DTR list by substation and feeder name (about 3 in 4 feeders match); unmatched feeders are left out and coverage is in inputs.
flags.as_on_from_work_order_tab: The smart-meter status tab has no date; the dashboard (and this metric) use the Date cell of the work-order tab of the same workbook (12/11/2025).
flags.columns_inferred_from_page_labels: Merged headers are lost in the export; columns follow important_sheets.html (I = under 10 units, M = zero units).
